description: Details required by Condition 4 (Submission of details) of planning permission 26/00910 (Variation of condition 2 (Compliance with approved drawings) of planning permission ref. PP/24/08064  (Application for the creation of new single front door; demolition and reconstruction of closet wing with enlarged basement; formation of rear extension link and infill extensions with rear terrace; fenestration alterations to rear elevation, comprising of new windows and Juliette balconies; improvements to roof form, together with external plant and glazed maintenance access hatch; and other associated works) to allow for the extension of the approved basement by approximately 78sqm, reduction in the extent of courtyard at basement level and erection of trellis to sections of west boundary brick wall.).
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
